pages.name: Fingerprinting
pages.description: Reads the browser's fingerprinting surface: navigator, screen, window, WebGL, audio, media devices, permissions, temporal and request-header properties.

pages.name: Storage blocking
pages.description: Reads back every client-side storage mechanism — cookies (JS and header, first and third party), localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cache API, service workers.

pages.name: Request blocking
pages.description: Loads a tracking third party through every request path a page has: script, image, stylesheet, iframe, fetch, XHR, web worker, websocket, beacon.

pages.name: Blocking behaviour
pages.description: Observes how a blocked request surfaces to the page: what fetch (basic, CORS, no-CORS) and XHR (async, sync) report when the response never arrives.

pages.name: Global Privacy Control
pages.description: Reads the Global Privacy Control signal from the top-level page, from frames, and from the request headers of sub-resources.

pages.name: HTTPS upgrades
pages.description: Loads plain-HTTP sub-resources and navigations to observe whether they are upgraded, and how an upgrade is reported to the page.

pages.name: HTTPS upgrade loop protection
pages.description: Navigates a host that redirects an upgraded request back to HTTP, checking a browser breaks the resulting upgrade/downgrade loop.

pages.name: AMP loop protection
pages.description: Follows an AMP link that rewrites back to its AMP form, checking a browser resolves it to the canonical page rather than looping.

pages.name: Surrogates
pages.description: Loads a tracker script from several document positions and checks whether a stand-in implementation is exposed to the page in its place. Runs on load; it has no start button.
